name: Zivan
description: A once-legendary Azorius legislator who fell into Rakdos pleasure houses and was found dead with words carved over his body.

description_citations.text: "The Shadows of Prahv, Part 2" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2012.

timeline.summary: Javy leads Relov to a tenement where he sees Zivan's corpse, words carved into every inch of his skin.
timeline.quote: Words had been magically imprinted over every inch of the dead man's body.

citation.text: "The Shadows of Prahv, Part 2" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2012.

timeline.summary: Javy asks about Zivan; Relov recounts that he was a respected Arbiter who squandered his talent in Rakdos pleasure houses.
timeline.quote: But he squandered it in Rakdos pleasure houses and hasn't been one of us for quite some time.

citation.text: "The Shadows of Prahv, Part 2" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2012.

timeline.summary: Gebris blames the Golgari for planning the raid, and Branko agrees to move the prisoners through the sunlit exercise yard to the South Block pens.
timeline.quote: "Let's take them through the exercise yard," Gebris urged.

citation.text: "The Shadows of Prahv, Part 1" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2012.
